hero.speaker: André
lines: Hello, traveler! I'm André, an Endpoint Engineer in Rio de Janeiro.
I automate infrastructure: I test hardware, standardize machines and write scripts that run on their own — every test returns PASS or FAIL.
The inventory below holds the items I've forged, from the lab to open-source products. Oh… and keep an eye out for hidden gems along the way.
